summary: Both #ds106 and #indieweb start with a place of "I " first yet these self-motivated goals often fit the larger shared endeavor. Yet I have always wondered if this "I" first approach draws on Western traditions and Kantian humanism that other worldviews may not fit. #el30
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Both #ds106 and #indieweb start with a place of "I " first yet these self-motivated goals often fit the larger shared endeavor. Yet I have always wondered if this "I" first approach draws on Western traditions and Kantian humanism that other worldviews may not fit. #el30
